onboarding.title: Welcome to PosturePal
onboarding.description: We will need access to your camera to monitor your posture. All processing happens locally — no images are uploaded.

webcam.denied: Camera access denied. Open System Settings to grant permission.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: Sit naturally facing your camera. We will capture a 5-second baseline of your normal posture. Future alerts compare against this baseline AND against clinical safe ranges.
calibration.samplesCaptured: Baseline captured from {{count}} samples — within healthy clinical range.

unsafe.title: Calibration outside healthy range
unsafe.description: It seems your posture during calibration was outside the clinical healthy range. For accurate monitoring, sit with your back straight, shoulders relaxed, and head aligned over your shoulders. Try again?

skipDialog.title: Skip safety check?
skipDialog.description: Baselines outside the clinical healthy range can mask real posture issues. The clinical safety layer will still catch breaches even if you skip — but for accurate personalized comparison, retrying with good posture is strongly recommended.

today.title: Today's timeline
today.description: Posture quality per hour (minutes per status).

week.title: This week
week.description: Daily totals across the last 7 days.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.description: Calibrate from the Monitor tab to start tracking. The Dashboard will fill in as data accumulates (one snapshot every 30 seconds).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how PosturePal monitors and alerts you.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: Calibration captures your individual posture. Sensitivity controls how much deviation triggers a warning vs poor verdict.

sensitivityDescription.low: Low — alerts on small deviations from your baseline (10% / 20%)
sensitivityDescription.high: High — alerts only on large deviations (25% / 50%)

clinicalLayer.label: Use clinical safety layer
clinicalLayer.description: Adds absolute thresholds from clinical research alongside your personal baseline. Status falls back to whichever layer is worse — protects against bad calibrations.

calibration.label: Calibration baseline
calibration.missing: No baseline yet — calibrate from the Monitor screen.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts when your posture needs attention.

test.label: Test notification
test.description: Verify your OS allows PosturePal to send notifications.
